data.name: Samiulla
data.gender_notes: Samiulla is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Samiulla is a name of Muslim origin, derived from the Arabic words 'Sami' meaning 'he who hears' and 'Allah' meaning 'God'. The name Samiulla thus translates to 'Follower of Allah'. The name Samiulla carries the meaning “Follower of Allah” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Samiulla usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samiulla is a name that represents devotion and commitment to Allah. It is a name that inspires one to be a true servant of God.
data.etymology: Samiulla belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samiulla total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
